jobs.title: Senior Ethernet Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
About the Role
Intel's Networking Solutions Group is seeking a strategic and customer-focused Senior Product Manager to help define and drive the next generation of Ethernet networking products for cloud, enterprise, and communications service provider markets.

In this role, you will shape product strategy, influence technology roadmaps, and partner closely with engineering, architecture, sales, and marketing teams to deliver innovative networking solutions that address evolving customer and industry needs. You will serve as a key voice of the customer, translating market insights into differentiated products that strengthen Intel's leadership in networking and data center technologies.

This role offers the opportunity to drive business impact through product innovation, customer engagement, market analysis, and cross-functional leadership.

What You’ll Do
Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:
- Partner with architecture and engineering teams to establish next gen product requirements and guide future product investments.
- Gather, analyze, and prioritize customer requirements and convert them into clear product specifications and execution plans.
- Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and customer engagement activities to identify emerging trends, opportunities, and potential market disruptions.
- Develop business cases, pricing strategies, cost models, and long-range revenue forecasts to support product decisions.
- Partner with sales, marketing, and ecosystem teams to define product positioning and support go-to-market execution.
- Develop compelling customer-facing presentations, product collateral, and value propositions that accelerate customer adoption.
- Build relationships with strategic customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to understand evolving networking requirements.
- Represent Intel at industry forums, customer meetings, conferences, and standards activities.
- Influence cross-functional teams to achieve product milestones throughout the product lifecycle.

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:
- Strategic thinking, customer focus, and data-driven decision-making, with the ability to translate market insights and customer requirements into successful product strategies and business outcomes.
- Strong collaboration, communication, and influencing skills, with a proven ability to drive alignment across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
- A high degree of ownership, accountability, and sound judgment, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Adaptability, learning agility, and a continuous improvement mindset to stay ahead of evolving technologies, industry trends, and customer needs.

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.
See  Intel Benefits  for more details.

Qualifications:

You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Note:
This position is not eligible for Intel immigration sponsorship.

Minimum Qualifications and Experience :
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field with 5+ years of Industry experience

- 10+ plus years of relevant industry experience in datacenters, servers, or Ethernet Networking
- 10+ years of product management experience or technical management experience
- 5+ years of networking protocols and data center system architectures
- 5+ years developing product business value proposition

How to Stand out (Preferred Qualifications and Experience) :
- Master's degree in business administration (MBA) or advanced engineering degree

- Familiarity with Cloud, Telco and Enterprise data center deployments with a focus on networking solutions
- Experience with ASIC/SoC development cycles and vendor management.
- Experience in contract negotiations and background in supply chain operations for silicon products

Why Join Intel
Join a team that is redefining the future of networking and data center infrastructure. In this role, you will help shape industry-leading Ethernet solutions, influence product strategy, and collaborate with world-class teams to deliver technologies that enable the next generation of cloud, enterprise, and communications networks. You'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while growing your leadership, business, and technical expertise.

jobs.title: Networking Hardware Product Manager
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Sr. Director Product Management, Network Solutions Group - GR11
The Sr. Director of Product Management serves as the senior product owner for Intel's Infrastructure Processing Unit (IPU) and Ethernet controller and adapter portfolio, with end-to-end responsibility for product vision, strategy, definition, positioning, and lifecycle management across Data Center, Enterprise, Edge, and Embedded markets. This role leads a team and reports directly to the General Manager of the Business Unit.

Defines and drives long-range product and portfolio strategy based on customer requirements, market dynamics, competitive intelligence, technology trends, and Intel business priorities. Translates these insights into differentiated product requirements, multi-year roadmaps, investment priorities, and new product opportunities that strengthen Intel's networking portfolio and support business growth.
Owns new product definition from concept through execution, partnering closely with architecture, engineering, design, manufacturing, test, quality, operations, sales, and marketing. Collaborates with platform and system architects to evaluate emerging technologies and customer use cases, assess technical and business tradeoffs, and influence future silicon, platform, and system capabilities.

Leads and develops a high-performing product management team responsible for executing the portfolio strategy. Sets clear priorities and expectations, establishes ownership and accountability, develops product management capabilities and technical expertise, and coaches team members to deliver business and customer outcomes. Builds organizational capability through talent development, succession planning, and effective deployment of resources against the highest-priority opportunities.
Serves as a key interface to strategic customers and ecosystem partners, developing a deep understanding of current and emerging networking requirements and translating those needs into actionable product strategy. Influences internal technology roadmaps and investment decisions based on customer insights, competitive dynamics, and long-term market opportunities.
Defines product positioning, value propositions, and competitive differentiation for Data Center, Enterprise, Edge, and Embedded applications. Partners with sales, marketing, and communications teams to develop go-to-market strategies, enable customer adoption, and successfully launch products worldwide.

Owns the complete product lifecycle from cradle to grave, including product introduction, ramp, sustaining, optimization, technology transitions, modifications, upgrades, and end-of-life decisions. Evaluates portfolio performance, customer adoption, market opportunity, and competitive positioning to inform ongoing investment and lifecycle decisions.
Leads complex, cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple organizations and geographies, establishing priorities, and driving alignment where successful outcomes require significant technical and business tradeoffs. Communicates product vision, strategy, roadmap, investment rationale, and business implications to executive leadership, customers, and other key stakeholders.
Uses deep networking technology expertise, extensive industry knowledge, customer insight, and business acumen to anticipate market transitions, identify new opportunities, and influence Intel's long-range networking strategy. Operates with a high degree of autonomy and serves as a recognized product and market authority for the portfolio.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant industry experience.
• 12+ years of experience in product management, product strategy, engineering, architecture, technical marketing, or a related role within the semiconductor, networking, data center, or infrastructure technology industry.
• 5+ years of experience leading product strategy, product definition, or lifecycle management for complex hardware or hardware/software products.
• Demonstrated technical knowledge of Ethernet and networking technologies, including network interface controllers (NICs), Ethernet controllers/adapters, infrastructure processing units (IPUs/DPUs/SmartNICs), or related data center networking technologies.
• Demonstrated experience translating customer, market, and competitive requirements into product strategy, product requirements, and multi-year roadmaps.
• Experience managing products through multiple stages of the product lifecycle, including new product definition, development, launch, production, sustaining, and end-of-life.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives across engineering, architecture, operations, sales, marketing, and other business functions.
• Experience engaging directly with strategic customers and/or ecosystem partners and translating technical requirements into product and business decisions.
• Demonstrated ability to communicate and influence effectively across technical, business, and executive-level audiences.
Preferred Qualifications
• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline and/or MBA.
• 15+ years of semiconductor, networking, data center, or infrastructure industry experience.
• Deep knowledge of Ethernet networking, data center architectures, NICs, IPUs/DPUs/SmartNICs, accelerators, or related silicon and platform technologies.
• Experience defining or managing networking silicon, adapters, boards, or platform-level products.
• Experience developing product strategies for Data Center, Cloud, Enterprise, Edge, and/or Embedded markets.
• Experience working directly with hyperscalers, cloud service providers, OEMs, ODMs, enterprise customers, or other strategic ecosystem partners.
• Demonstrated experience developing business cases, assessing market opportunities, influencing investment decisions, and driving product portfolio strategy.
• Experience developing product positioning, competitive strategy, go-to-market plans, and customer adoption strategies for highly technical products.
• Track record of influencing senior executives and leading across complex global organizations without direct authority.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Data Center
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Intel is shaping the future of data center computing through technologies powering critical cloud, AI, enterprise, and high-performance computing workloads.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Data Center to drive the strategy, execution, and lifecycle of next-generation Intel® Xeon® products. This highly visible role operates at the intersection of technology, customers, and business strategy , translating market insights, customer needs, and technical trade-offs into product decisions that strengthen competitive positioning and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical acumen, strategic thinking, customer focus, and the ability to influence senior stakeholders across a highly matrixed organization.

What You'll Do
Responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

Product Ownership & Lifecycle Leadership
- Own a Xeon product through its full lifecycle: product definition, planning, development, production, launch, and end‑of‑life.
- Serve as the central point of coordination across design, architecture, process technology, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing.
- Maintain lifecycle accountability, including upgrades, feature changes, and product sustaining decisions.

Product Strategy & Roadmap Influence
- Apply competitive intelligence, customer insights, and workload analysis to influence product priorities within the broader Xeon portfolio framework.
- Partner with platform and system architects to assess emerging technologies and provide informed recommendations for future product investments.
- Translate customer and ecosystem feedback into actionable inputs for roadmap and feature decisions.

Competitive Positioning & Product Messaging
- Analyze the competitive landscape and define product positioning that clearly communicates customer value.
- Develop performance leadership narratives grounded in real workload KPIs, not just specifications.
- Support go‑to‑market planning and engage with customers and ecosystem partners to validate workloads, use cases, and performance targets.

Technology Readiness & Launch Execution
- Own workload and KPI readiness gates, driving execution across validation, debug, and performance optimization teams.
- Represent product readiness, risks, and mitigation plans in executive and cross‑organizational reviews.
- Support global product launches in partnership with marketing, communications, PR, and sales enablement teams.

Cross‑Functional Leadership
- Align engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and business stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and definitions of success.
- Drive convergence across validation, debug, and performance teams to ensure outcomes reflect real customer requirements.
- Operate effectively in a highly matrixed environment, influencing without direct authority.

Behavioral traits that we are looking for:
- Strategic thinker with strong business judgment.
- Customer-focused and data-driven.
- Strong executive communication and influence.
- Comfortable making decisions in ambiguous environments.
- Proven ability to align senior stakeholders without direct authority.
- Strong ownership and results orientation.

Intel invests in our people and offers a complete and competitive package of benefits employees and their families through every stage of life.
- See  Intel Benefits  for more details.

Qualifications:
You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. Preferred qualifications are in addition to the minimum requirements and are considered a plus factor in identifying top candidates.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's in Electrical /Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or STEM related field with 7+ year of experience.
- 7+ years of experience in semiconductor product management, technical marketing, or product architecture.
- 7+ years of experience owning end‑to‑end hardware or platform products, including launch and lifecycle.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Demonstrated depth operating at the system or platform level.
- Proven track record owning product decisions under ambiguity — including setting success criteria, driving tradeoffs, and carrying consequences.
- Demonstrated ability to lead senior engineering stakeholders without direct authority.
- Ability to articulate a coherent product narrative that connects architecture intent, workload performance, competitive positioning, and customer value.
- MBA or equivalent experience translating technical tradeoffs into business, portfolio, and market implications.
- Direct experience with server or datacenter platform business involving CPU, memory, and I/O.
- Demonstrated exposure to hyperscale, CSP, or OEM/ODM customers or ecosystems.
- Hands‑on involvement with workload‑based performance or benchmarking frameworks (e.g., MLPerf, SPEC, TPC, or equivalent internal systems).

Why Join Intel?
Help shape the future of data center computing by driving Intel® Xeon® products that power critical cloud, AI, and enterprise workloads worldwide. Collaborate with leading technologists and customers to turn breakthrough innovation into meaningful business and customer impact. Apply today and help define what’s next in data center computing.

jobs.title: Product Manager – AI Software and Solution
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Job Description
We are seeking a visionary, strategic, and technically deep Senior Product Manager to define, build, and scale our Data Center AI Software Portfolio. In this role, you will be the primary strategist and execution leader driving end-customer-facing software solutions for Intel's high-growth Data Center accelerator products.
You will lead the end-to-end product strategy for our generative AI software stack, with a specific focus on use-case-driven Agentic toolkits, containerized microservices, and enterprise-grade, ready-to-deploy (turnkey) solutions. Your mission is to democratize high-performance accelerated computing by removing the complexities of AI deployment, establishing a robust developer ecosystem, and creating highly competitive, open-standards-based software offerings that challenge industry incumbents.

Key Responsibilities
1. Portfolio Strategy and Roadmap Ownership
• Define and Scale: Own the product lifecycle, strategic vision, and execution roadmap for Intel's Data Center AI Software and customer experiences.
• Turnkey Solutions: Drive the definition and productization of enterprise-ready, out-of-the-box (OOTB) software solutions (cloud, hybrid, and on-premises) that enable seamless AI deployment.
• Agentic and Microservices Ecosystem: Lead the strategy for modular AI software architectures, focusing on industry compliant microservices, Hetro frameworks, and Agentic AI toolkits.
2. Competitive Positioning and Market Intelligence
• Market Disruption: Maintain deep, continuous analysis of competitor hardware/software stacks to identify market whitespace, software gaps, and unique value-proposition vectors for Intel's hardware.
• GTM: Collaborate with Product Marketing and Business Development to establish competitive software offering, licensing, and product packages that drive high volume adoption.
3. Developer and Partner Enablement
• Ecosystem Growth: Foster strong relationships with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs), emerging Neoclouds, Independent Software Vendors (ISVs), and the open-source AI community (Hugging Face, PyTorch, LangChain, etc.).
• Turnkey Blueprints: Deliver developer-friendly reference architectures, deployment blueprints (Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm Charts, and Terraform), and system telemetry integrations.
• Frictionless Onboarding: Work closely with the technical documentation and developer relation teams to ensure APIs, SDKs, and toolkits are exceptionally well-documented and simple to adopt.
4. Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Engineering Alignment: Partner intimately with software engineering, AI researchers, and silicon architecture teams to translate complex customer challenges into clear PRDs (Product Requirement Documents) and engineering backlogs.
• Shift-Left Methodologies: Coordinate with simulators, emulation, and validation teams to ensure software readiness prior to hardware tap-out.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a highly technical quantitative discipline. (An MBA or advanced technical degree is highly preferred).
• Experience: 10+ years of product management, product engineering, or technical marketing experience in the data center, cloud-native, or enterprise software domain.
• AI/ML Technical Domain Expertise: 3+ years of dedicated product leadership within deep learning, LLMs, generative AI stacks, or accelerated computing.
• Cloud-Native Proficiency: Practical understanding of cloud-native orchestration tools (Kubernetes, Red Hat OpenShift), containerization (Docker), and modern microservice mesh architectures.

Preferred Qualifications
• AI Software Knowledge: Direct experience with GPU software stack from middleware to frameworks to Agentic toolkits.
• AI System Design: Proven track record of productizing RAG applications, Agentic AI, vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Redis, Qdrant), or complex AI orchestration frameworks.
• Enterprise Software Delivery: Experience working with AI Inference deployment and Agentic frameworks is highly desirable
• Thriving in Ambiguity: Ability to successfully manage multiple complex, matrixed workstreams and drive alignment among diverse technical and business stakeholders globally.

Join us in shaping the future of software innovation and leveraging your expertise to make a meaningful impact in the dynamic world of data center solutions.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Data Center System and Manageability Software
jobs.description:
Job Details:

Job Description:
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to define, build, and scale our Data Center System and Manageability Software Portfolio. In this role, you will lead the strategy and execution for system software, firmware, telemetry, and out-of-band/in-band manageability capabilities, ensuring next-generation hyperscale and enterprise infrastructure operates reliably, securely, and efficiently at scale for Intel Datacenter GPUs.

Key Responsibilities
• Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define multi-generational product roadmaps for system software, firmware (UEFI/BMC), telemetry, and orchestration interfaces across data center GPU products.
• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner closely with silicon, platform hardware, firmware, OS, and cloud software engineering teams to align architectural dependencies and platform release schedules.
• Customer and Market Discovery: Drive deep technical discovery with cloud service providers (CSPs), enterprise customers, and OEMs/ODMs to translate complex infrastructure operational pain points into clear product requirements (PRDs).
• Fleet Manageability and Observability: Champion standard-based manageability (e.g., Redfish, OpenBMC, PLDM) and robust telemetry pipelines to ensure platforms are observable, controllable, and secure at hyperscale.
• Execution and Lifecycle Management: Own the complete lifecycle from PRD generation and engineering sprint prioritization to platform bring-up, validation, security patching, and end-of-life planning.

Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
• Experience: 10+ years of total experience, with 4+ years dedicated to technical product management in data center infrastructure, server platforms, or systems software.
• Deep domain expertise in server architecture, BMC firmware (OpenBMC), UEFI/BIOS, RAS (Reliability, Availability, Serviceability), out-of-band management, and platform security (Root of Trust, SPDM).
• Proven familiarity with industry standards including DMTF Redfish, IPMI, MCTP, PLDM, and PCIe / CXL manageability.
• Demonstrated success taking complex system software or platform firmware solutions from concept to high-volume production deployment.
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical industry experience (MS / MBA preferred).

Preferred Qualifications
• Practical experience designing manageability tools for hyperscale data centers or hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI).
• Active engagement with open-source firmware and hardware initiatives (e.g., Open Compute Project / OCP, Linux Foundation).
• Background in edge-to-cloud telemetry streaming, platform health modeling, or predictive failure analysis using machine learning.

Your impact as Manager of Software Product Management will be instrumental in shaping Intel's future success and driving transformative solutions in the tech industry. If you are ready to lead, innovate, and make a difference, we encourage you to bring your unique expertise to Intel and join us in redefining what's possible.
